fixture_notes: Two dated service rows retain one detail row and one grand-total row, isolating the rollup NULL label passed through COALESCE.
determinism_notes: Fixed dates, service codes, amounts, label literals, derived aliases, and final ordering; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE mini_service_revenue (revenue_id INT PRIMARY KEY, billed_at DATETIME NOT NULL, service_code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, amount INT NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT month_label, service_label, total_amount FROM (SELECT COALESCE(DATE_FORMAT(billed_at, '%Y-%m'), 'ALL MONTHS') AS month_label, COALESCE(service_code, 'ALL SERVICES') AS service_label, SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM mini_service_revenue GROUP BY COALESCE(DATE_FORMAT(billed_at, '%Y-%m'), 'ALL MONTHS'), service_code WITH ROLLUP) AS rollup_report ORDER BY month_label, service_label
